author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
The first snow brings a peaceful winter atmosphere to the village, while the warmth of the oven fills the home with the aroma of freshly baked samsa ❄️🔥 In this video, we prepare traditional beef samsa from scratch using homemade dough and a rich, savory filling.

The dough is carefully layered and shaped around seasoned beef, then baked until beautifully golden and crisp. Inside, the filling stays juicy and flavorful, making each samsa warm, hearty, and perfect for a cold snowy day.

Traditional beef samsa is a comforting village favorite — flaky pastry, savory meat, and the warmth of homemade baking. A perfect winter meal to enjoy with family while the snow falls outside. 🥩🥐🌨️
title: First Snow, Warm Oven | Traditional Beef Samsa in the Village ❄️🔥
